title: Session transcript
description: One completed practice session. turn_ids are stable and are the anchor targets for all feedback claims.

role.description: 'companion' = a third party present in the scenario (e.g. the person a traveler defers to). The engine may voice companions; indicators like third-party-answers depend on companion turns being distinguishable.

audio_ref.description: Reference to stored audio for this turn (voice mode), else null. Storage scheme TBD at split.

value.description: Trainee's committed decision at session end.

stated_reason.description: Optional: trainee's one-line reason, useful for feedback + eval.
